source.title: Vadose zone analytical algorithm (VZAA): a non-iterative algorithm for vadose zone soil moisture and groundwater recharge

coordinate_and_flux_sign.f: positive downward as used in Eq. 1 and the D0 evidence convention
coordinate_and_flux_sign.history_sign_check: For wetting, theta increments are positive and Eq. 5 makes H negative; the Eq. 3 term -sqrt(cD)H is therefore positive/downward.

bound_equations.eq6: c=0.5 when H<=0; c=2 when H>0

d0a_deep_groundwater_specialization.Kd: treated as negligible only for the D0-A deep-groundwater/free-drainage diagnostic
d0a_deep_groundwater_specialization.claim_limit: This specialization does not qualify shallow-groundwater or prescribed-head coupling; those remain D0-C or later.

hydraulic_compatibility_with_lmfp04.decision: Use the published VG Eq. 15 and Eq. 17 directly for the VZAA diagnostic. Do not substitute a numerical K/C diffusivity reconstruction and do not use a post-hoc fitted hydraulic relation.

domain_policy.outside_or_singular: record hydraulic-domain failure; do not clip to manufacture a finite donor value
domain_policy.nonfinite: record diagnostic failure and retain the row in evidence
